evidence: The HGeCl3, (Me3Si)2Te, and Te(OEt)4 were used as Ge and Te sources. The vapor was delivered with the aid of a 100 sccm/min flow of Ar carrier gas. The ALD pedestal temperature was set to 60 °C, and the chamber pressure was stabilized at 500 mTorr during the deposition of GeTe and 2000 mTorr during the Te deposition. The GeTe ALD sequence alternated (Me3Si)2Te and HGeCl3 pulses separated by Ar purge pulses; for the Te process, an (Me3Si)2Te-Ar-Te(OEt)4-Ar sequence was used.
